preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 100000 for N in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.strip()) > 100000 for _ in [1])])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p < i+1 for i, p in enumerate(parents_list, start=1) for parents_list in [line.split() for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the parent array p_1, ..., p_{N-1} satisfies 1 <= p_i < i+1, ensuring a valid tree rooted at 1.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.
Each output line contains a single non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[i]) == max_subtree_mex_sum(N, parents) for i, (N, parents) in enumerate(parse_test_cases(stdin_text)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer equals the maximum possible sum of subtree MEX values achievable by optimally assigning distinct integers from 0 to N-1 to the nodes.
